title: Flight Info Display Error — Gate B4

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hey Ops, this is Skyline at Gate B4. The screen above the gate says this flight is going to 'Miami', but my flight is going to 'Minneapolis'. Passengers are confused. Can you fix the typo?

transcript.speaker: callee
transcript.text: Got it, Skyline. We’ll check the FIDS feed and update the display. Hold on.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thanks. There’s a group of 12 passengers already at the gate—some are starting to ask if they’re on the wrong flight.

transcript.speaker: callee
transcript.text: Understood. We’ll prioritize this. AOC, on it.

instructorNote: This is a core narrative inject; the IT team should begin investigating the FIDS data feed. Watch for overconfidence in dismissing the error as minor.
